chunks: And al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmud, who said:

I said to al-Rida عليه السلام: “A carpet and bedding are affected by urine; what should be done with them when they are thick and heavily stuffed?” He said: “Whatever of its surface appears is washed on its face.”

key_terms.الْبَوْلُ: urine as a source of najasah
key_terms.وَجْهِهِ: its outward face or visible surface

ai.seo_question: How should a thick carpet or mattress be purified if urine reaches it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning purification of thick, heavily padded furnishings contaminated by urine. Imam al-Rida عليه السلام instructs that the visible outer surface is to be washed, indicating practical guidance in cases where full internal washing is difficult.
